arxiv-1910-01509.title: Control of spintronic and electronic properties of bimetallic and vacancy-ordered vanadium carbide MXenes via surface functionalization
arxiv-1910-01509.creator: Shuo LiDepartment of Physical and Macromolecular Chemistry, Faculty of ScienceCharles University in Prague, 128 43 Prague 2, Czech Republic lishu@natur.cuni.cz Junjie HeBremen Center for Computational Materials ScienceUniversity of Bremen, Am Fallturm 1, 28359 Bremen, GermanyPetr NachtigallDepartmen
arxiv-1910-01509.description: Abstract MXenes are 2D transition metal carbides with high potential for overcoming limitations of conventional two-dimensional electronics. In this context, various MXenes have shown magnetic properties suitable for applications in spintronics, yet the number of MXenes reported so far is far smaller than their parental MAX phases.

arxiv-2102-02333.title: Entanglement cost for steering assemblages
arxiv-2102-02333.creator: Thomas Cope
arxiv-2102-02333.description: Abstract In this paper we answer the question of how one can quantify the amount of entanglement necessary to create a given steering assemblage, when the original state and measurements are unknown. To do this, we extend the concepts of entanglement cost and entanglement of formation to steering assemblages, and provide easy to calculate upper and lower bounds.

arxiv-2103-16052.title: Nematic and smectic stripe phases and stripe-SkX transformations
arxiv-2103-16052.creator: Hai-Tao Wu, Xu-Chong Hu, X. R. Wang
arxiv-2103-16052.description: Abstract Based on the findings of skyrmion nature of stripes and the metastability of a state of an arbitrary number of skyrmions, precisely controlled manipulation of stripes of skyrmion number 1 in pre-designed structures and mutual transformation between helical states and skyrmion crystals (SkXs) are demonstrated in chiral magnetic films.

arxiv-2108-12293.title: A Framework for Supervised Heterogeneous Transfer Learning using Dynamic Distribution Adaptation and Manifold Regularization PubID: pubid: 0000–0000/00$00.00 © 2022 IEEE
arxiv-2108-12293.creator: Md Geaur Rahman and Md Zahidul Islam
arxiv-2108-12293.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Md Geaur Rahman and Md Zahidul Islam. Transfer learning aims to learn classifiers for a target domain by transferring knowledge from a source domain. However, due to two main issues: feature discrepancy and distribution divergence, transfer learning can be a very difficult problem in practice. In this paper, we present a framework called TLF that builds a classifier for the target domain having only a few labeled training records by transferring knowledge from the source domain having many labeled records.

arxiv-2203-16846.title: Active Galactic Nuclei and their demography through cosmic time
arxiv-2203-16846.creator: Stefano Bianchi and Vincenzo Mainieri and Paolo Padovani
arxiv-2203-16846.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Stefano Bianchi and Vincenzo Mainieri and Paolo Padovani. Active Galactic Nuclei (AGN) are highly energetic astrophysical sources powered by accretion onto supermassive black holes in galaxies, which present unique observational signatures covering the full electromagnetic spectrum (and more) over about twenty orders of magnitude in frequency. We first review the main AGN properties and diversities and show that they can be explained by a small number of parameters.

arxiv-2303-15907.title: Group rings of three-manifold groups
arxiv-2303-15907.creator: Dawid Kielak, Marco Linton
arxiv-2303-15907.description: Abstract . Let G G be the fundamental group of a three-manifold. By piecing together many known facts about three manifold groups, we establish two properties of the group ring ℂ ​ G \mathbb{C}G . We show that if G G has rational cohomological dimension two, then ℂ ​ G \mathbb{C}G is coherent.

arxiv-2306-03695.title: Dynamics of Ordered Active Columns: Flows, Twists, and Waves
arxiv-2306-03695.creator: S. J. Kole, Gareth P. Alexander, Ananyo Maitra, Sriram Ramaswamy
arxiv-2306-03695.description: Abstract We formulate the hydrodynamics of active columnar phases, with two-dimensional translational order in the plane perpendicular to the columns and no elastic restoring force for relative sliding of the columns, using the general formalism of an active model H ∗ .

arxiv-2403-12673.description: Abstract In this article, we prove that if ( 𝒜 , ℬ , 𝒞 ) (\mathcal{A},\mathcal{B},\mathcal{C}) is a recollement of extriangulated categories, then n n -cotorsion pairs in 𝒜 \mathcal{A} and 𝒞 \mathcal{C} can induce n n -cotorsion pairs in ℬ \mathcal{B} . arxiv-2405-14956.title: Interpretable and Editable Programmatic Tree Policies for Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2405-14956.creator: Hector Kohler, Quentin Delfosse, Riad Akrour, Kristian Kersting, Philippe Preux
arxiv-2405-14956.description: Abstract Deep reinforcement learning agents are prone to goal misalignments. The black-box nature of their policies hinders the detection and correction of such misalignments, and the trust necessary for real-world deployment. So far, solutions learning interpretable policies are inefficient or require many human priors. We propose INTERPRETER 1 1 1 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/tuto-interpreter-C56E/tuto-interpreter.

arxiv-2412-17988.title: Network Models of Expertise in the Complex Task of Operating Particle Accelerators
arxiv-2412-17988.description: Abstract We implement a network-based approach to study expertise in a complex real-world task: operating particle accelerators. Most real-world tasks we learn and perform (e.g., driving cars, operating complex machines and devices, solving mathematical problems) are difficult to learn because they are complex, and the best strategies are difficult to find from many possibilities.

arxiv-2511-17731.title: VisReason : A Large-Scale Dataset for Visual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
arxiv-2511-17731.creator: Lingxiao Li, Yifan Wang, Xinyan Gao, Chen Tang, Xiangyu Yue, Chenyu You
arxiv-2511-17731.description: Abstract Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has proven remarkably effective for eliciting complex reasoning in large language models (LLMs). Yet, its potential in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains largely untapped, hindered by the absence of large-scale datasets that capture the rich, spatially grounded reasoning intrinsic to visual understanding.

britannica-1911-loyola-st-ignatius-of.description: Article 'Loyola, St Ignatius of' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 17), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. pmc-10555791.creator: Keya Thakkar, Rollie Hampton, Maria Jimenez Gonzalez, Diego Espinoza, Sarah Stanley
pmc-10555791.description: Disclosure: K. Thakkar: None. R. Hampton: None. M. Jimenez Gonzalez: None. D. Espinoza: None. S. Stanley: None. These effects occur partly via sympathetic innervation of pancreatic islets.

pmc-10643331.creator: Young-Saeng Jang, Sun-Hee Park, Seung-Goo Kang, Jung-Shin Lee, Hyun-Jeong Ko, Pyeung-Hyeun Kim
pmc-10643331.description: Forkhead box P3-positive (Foxp3+)-inducible Tregs (iTregs) are readily generated by TGF-β1 at low TCR signaling intensity. pmc-13111468.title: Development of a predictive model integrating urogenital pathogens and inflammatory markers for human papillomavirus infection
pmc-13111468.creator: Jingxi Zhang, Biyao Jiang, Juan Tao, Mengyu Chen, Songshu Xiao, Yafang Gong
pmc-13111468.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveThe objective of the present study was to evaluate the relationship between common urogenital pathogens and human papillomavirus (HPV) infection and to assess the impact of coinfections on vaginal microecology.MethodsThis hospital-based cross-sectional study included 330 reproductive-aged women. Multiplex polymerase chain reaction (PCR) was applied to detect Chlamydia trachomatis (CT), Neisseria gonorrhoeae (NG), Ureaplasma urealyticum (UU), Ureaplasma parvum (UP), Mycoplasma hominis (MH), and Mycoplasma genitalium (MG). HPV DNA genotyping was also performed.

pmc-13230507.title: Enhancing the capabilities of large language models for API calls through knowledge graphs
pmc-13230507.creator: Ye Yang, Xue Xiao, Ping Yin, Taotao Xie, Yang Ye
pmc-13230507.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). API calls by large language model (LLM) represent a cutting-edge technique in data analysis. However, the potential of LLM to effectively utilize tools through API calls remains underexplored in knowledge-intensive sectors such as the meteorological industry. In this paper, we propose a system, named KG2data, that integrates knowledge graphs, LLM, React agents, and tool usage technologies to perform API calls for intelligent data acquisition and query handling in the meteorological domain.

pmc-13540314.title: Eltrombopag Added to Standard Immunosuppressive Treatment as Front‐Line Therapy for Severe Aplastic Anemia: Long‐Term Outcomes of the Phase‐3 Randomized Superiority EBMT‐SAAWP RACE Study

pmc-13540314.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The RACE study (NCT02009747) compared horse antithymocyte globulin (hATG) plus cyclosporine A (CsA) ± eltrombopag as initial immunosuppressive treatment (IST) for severe aplastic anemia. Here we report the final 2‐year analysis of this prospective randomized phase III study.
